news.title: ACE Releases New Guidance to Help Campuses Protect Civic Engagement During the 2026 Election Cycle
news.summary_en: As colleges and universities prepare for the upcoming fall semester and the 2026 midterm elections, ACE has released an updated issue brief: Voting and College Political Campaign Related- Activities in America’s 250th Year.
